dedupe_keys.name: synthetic farm population of north rhine westphalia germany at plot and farm scale pahmeyer

description: A synthetic population of farms for the German state of North Rhine-Westphalia, built mainly from the German Farm Structure Survey 2016 and plot-level crop data from 2019 and 2020. The Mendeley Data record says the data are given at plot scale as geospatial vectors and at farm scale as tables: for each plot it records the farm it belongs to (with the farm's estimated location), the farm's animal stock, the crop grown and the administrative units, joined to further spatial data such as yields, soil properties and environmental monitoring. It is meant for farm-level and agent-based models, and as a case study for testing models that need detailed, spatially explicit farm data. Version 1 was published on 28 January 2021 by Christoph Pahmeyer, free under CC BY 4.0, as five downloadable files: farm data in CSV (11.7 MB) and Excel (7.2 MB), plot data in zipped CSV (66 MB) and zipped shapefile (148 MB), and a zipped GeoJSON (149 MB). Coverage is all farm plots in the state. Caveats: farm locations and links between plots and farms are estimated, so the population is synthetic, not a register. For simulation it seeds agent-based models of farm responses to drought, flood or price shocks, and the demand for rural water, energy and transport. A related catalogue record is the harmonised IACS inventory of field crop declarations in Europe.
